meta.name: planning-with-files
meta.description: Persistent file-based planning for multi-step AI-agent work. Keeps task_plan.md, findings.md, and progress.md on disk; lifecycle hooks inject selected project planning context. Automatic recovery reads project planning files only. Explicit session-catchup.py --metadata reads same-project local agent session records and emits aggregate counts only; --replay may emit bounded nonce-framed excerpts. Optional gated mode can request continuation only when the host supports it and never runs commands declared in Markdown. The skill has no network upload path. Use for research or work needing 5+ tool calls.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把多步任务的任务计划与进展写进文件,任务中断后还能接着往下做
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上的任务步骤多、耗时长,中途容易断线需要接续
copy.tagline_en: Save task plans and progress to disk so multi-step agent work can resume later
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your task spans many steps and must survive interruptions

howto.what: Claude 会把任务计划、发现、进度写进项目里的三个 markdown 文件(task_plan.md、findings.md、progress.md),按阶段推进并在每阶段后更新状态、记录报错;上下文丢失或被 /clear 后仍靠这些文件接着做。
howto.when: 当你要求规划、拆分或组织多步骤项目或研究任务,或这项工作要求 5 次以上工具调用时进入这套文件化流程。

say.text: 帮我把这个多步骤任务拆成计划,写进 task_plan.md
say.note: 会先建规划文件再动手

say.text: 继续上次没做完的工作,先检查有没有未同步的上下文
say.note: 读同一项目的会话记录并汇总

say.text: 把这次的调研发现记到 findings.md,并更新进度

howto.what_en: Claude writes the task plan, findings, and progress into three markdown files in your project, works phase by phase, and updates status and errors after each phase; work survives context loss and /clear.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to plan, break down, or organize a multi-step project or research task, or when the work needs 5+ tool calls.

say_en.text: Break this multi-step task into a plan and write it to task_plan.md

Log these research findings in findings.md and update progress
